text:
Emma (sales): quick question — BigBank wants an air-gapped POC. Need definitive answers on packaging format, how we sign bundles, offline license activation, and upgrade cadence. Also pricing for a single-customer on-prem license. Any blockers? :eyes:
Sam (eng-runtime): we can produce a tarball installer + checksums. prefer gpg detached sigs. we don't currently support customer KMS signing in the bundle; sign with Redwood key unless they provide signing keys.
BenOps: for airgap installs we do offline installer tar.gz + container images as OCI tarball. delivery via S3 presigned isn't usable. we recommend a secure USB or internal registry import. can we confirm size limits? many customers want <20GB.
Nina (security): security Qs: do we provide SBOM? yes. do we support reproducible builds? partial — we can include image digests and SBOM v1.41. customer requires FIPS-certified crypto for signing — we need to check. also they asked for attestations.
Sam (eng-runtime): SBOM included. recommended upgrade cadence: security patches monthly, minor features quarterly, major versions annual. can support ad-hoc security hotfixes with signed delta patches. delta patch flow uses signed manifests + rsync/patch scripts.
Maya (solutions): For pricing: typical structure = one-time on-prem package fee + annual support (20-25% of license) + optional onsite assist. for a POC we can offer a short trial license + reduced setup fee. I'll follow up with exact numbers.
Leo (product): note: Private product requires customer to pin model versions; we can ship param config and quantized weights. confirm if they need airgap model sync (we can provide model bundle + md5/sha256 and signature).
BenOps: operations note — upgrade cadence impacts rollback strategy. recommend keep two retained releases in local registry for quick fallback. backup KV cache before upgrades.
Nina (security): also need to confirm network constraints: no outbound at all? if no outbound, telemetry & metrics must be routed to their internal splunk/elk via our push script only.
Emma (sales): @Maya please send draft pricing. @Sam @BenOps high-priority: can you each validate bundle size under 25GB and GPG sign flow by EOD?
Sam (eng-runtime): will test signing flow today. sharing minimal commands:

```
tar czf redwood-bundle-1.0.0.tar.gz ./images ./manifests ./sbom.json
sha256sum redwood-bundle-1.0.0.tar.gz > redwood-bundle-1.0.0.sha256
gpg --output redwood-bundle-1.0.0.sig --detach-sig redwood-bundle-1.0.0.tar.gz
```

Sam (eng-runtime): also note: for delta patches we use `rdw-patch` tool that generates signed manifests.
Deploy-bot: artifact uploaded: redwood-bundle-1.0.0.tar.gz (sha256: a3f5b2e7c9d4f1b2a1e6c7d8f9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8)
BenOps: confirmed bundle gz ~18.9GB from local build. passing SBOM -> yes. we'll test import into internal registry tomorrow.
Nina (security): Need to get legal on indemnity + export controls. BigBank requires CCATS? I'll loop in legal.
Maya (solutions): I'll draft pricing + POC scope and post here by 1805230400.
Emma (sales): awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
